findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first full quarter of Infosolutions (consolidated from 1 June; 2025 revenue 67 MSEK, of which 7 internal), with the 25% personnel cost cut already done in Q2 but the price increase only effective from year-end. So reported revenue growth should jump to about 30% while the EBITDA contribution stays small but positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The deal day (2026-04-27) closed +4.85%; Q2, where Infosolutions ARR came in above Redeye's expectations, closed +7.25% (22.75 -> 24.40).
findings.original_quote: Vi har därför, genomfört uppsägningar, vilket minskat kostnadsbasen med 25% ... Vi har även flaggat för kunder att vi höjer priserna, det får dock genomslag först vid årsskiftet. (We have therefore made layoffs, cutting the cost base by 25% ... We have also told customers we are raising prices, but that only takes effect at year-end.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the revenue scale and the cost cut are both disclosed. What is new is the first clean quarter of Infosolutions profitability after the cut. With one commissioned analyst and $112k a day of turnover, nobody is positioned on that number. Had it been priced, the 60-day +12.8% run-up would have come with a sell-side estimate change, and none is visible.
findings.independence: Redeye Q2 review (Finwire via Placera, 2026-07-13): Infosolutions' ARR contribution was higher than expected. https://www.placera.se/telegram/carasent-redeye-ser-fortsatt-uppsida-i-carasent-efter-solid-q2-rapport-20260713

findings.finding: The Q2 report described commercial momentum going into H2: very good Q2 sales to new customers and add-ons, including the Medsum AI assistant (paying users up from 13 in January to about 200 in June); 6 MSEK of signed-but-not-implemented ARR; organic ARR growth of 15% (17% in the Nordics); churn of 3%. That supports organic revenue growth moving up toward the 15% target from Q2's 11%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock trades on organic revenue growth against the 15% target: Q1 2026 organic 7% closed -4.97% (Placera attributes the fall to growth missing the target); Q2 organic 11% with ARR +15% closed +7.25%; Q3 2025 organic 13% closed +8.81%.
findings.original_quote: Vi hade också mycket god försäljning i Q2, både till nykund och tilläggstjänster, bland annat i form av vår AI assistent, det bådar gott inför resten av året. (We also had very good sales in Q2, both to new customers and in add-on services, including our AI assistant, which bodes well for the rest of the year.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since it was in the Q2 release and the stock rose 7% on it. What is not priced is whether the ARR conversion shows up as Q3 organic revenue growth at or near 15%, a number nobody has published (Yahoo consensus is empty, Redeye estimates unreachable). Had the market already credited it, the 20-day run-up would not be +0.4%.
findings.independence: Placera, 2026-04-14: the market punished the Q1 organic growth miss against the target, so this line is the one the reaction turns on. https://placera.se/nyheter/carasent-nar-vinst-men-missar-sitt-tillvaxtmal-2026-04-14

findings.finding: There are known H2 cost and cash headwinds: about 2 MSEK of extra MDR certification cost for Medsum in H2, a seasonally high Q3 2025 EBITDA comparison (23.6 MSEK, 29% margin), and a Q3 working-capital unwind of the 62 MSEK contract liability. Q3 2025 operating cash flow was only 2.5 MSEK, against 68 MSEK in H1 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q3 2025 the stock looked through 2.5 MSEK of operating cash flow and closed +8.81%, so this line has not been punished on this name before.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed, and the seasonal pattern is visible in last year's quarters, so it is mostly priced. It is filed because a weak cash quarter after an 68 MSEK H1 can read as a reversal on a thin tape, as the Luceco lesson showed.
findings.independence: Q2 balance sheet: contract liability (avtalsskuld) of 61,988 kSEK against 45,111 at year-end. https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a4125e26b448614b79e3627b5fade9d3d

findings.finding: Board member Johan Kallblad bought 58,999 shares on the open market on 26-27 August 2026 at 25.05-26.45 SEK (about 1.5 MSEK), in the open window after Q2. It is the largest insider purchase in the 2026 FI insynsregister for Carasent.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to insider purchases on this name; the stock went from 25.25 to 26.10 over the three sessions around the purchase.
findings.original_quote: Johan Kallblad | Styrelseledamot | Förvärv | Aktie | 2026-08-27 | 25 000 | Antal | 26,15 | SEK (Johan Kallblad, board member, acquisition, shares, 2026-08-27, 25,000 at 26.15 SEK)
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy that has been public for six weeks, and it is partly reflected in the move from 25 to 27 SEK. It is filed because a board member adding 1.5 MSEK in the window after Q2, more than his earlier purchases, is the only informed flow visible on a name with no disclosed short.

findings.finding: Västra Götalandsregionen formally terminated the Oracle Millennium contract (paying 657 MSEK) on 27 August 2026. This finally removes the requirement that put Webdoc's private primary-care customers in VGR at risk; Carasent filed a court ruling on that requirement as investor news in March 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-27 session closed +2.8% (25.25 -> 25.95) together with the insider purchase; it is not separable.
findings.original_quote: Västra Götalandsregionen säger upp avtalet om vårdsystemet Millennium – och betalar leverantören Oracle 657 miljoner kronor. (Region Västra Götaland terminates the contract for the Millennium care system and pays the supplier Oracle SEK 657 million.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the scrapping was recommended in November 2025 (https://www.tv4.se/artikel/69QKXQ4Q140TEkNkUrh2xf/foerslaget-skrota-millennium-helt). The only new element is that the CEO may cite it in the Q3 release as removed churn risk in the core Swedish market. It is a regional-to-company transmission, so it is small.
findings.independence: Carasent investor news, 2025-03-21: the Administrative Court rejected the healthcare providers' appeal against the Millennium requirement in primary care in VGR. https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b07a7d7c1db63c47e48c034b0f6e12d23&lang=en&src=listed

baseline_tension: The run-up controls are flat (+0.4% over 20 days, +3.5% over 5, +12.8% over 60) and there is no short anchor. My slight positive lean mildly agrees with the 60-day drift, and it rests on public Q2 statements rather than anything that cuts against the price.
language_note: The Q2 report's Swedish CEO letter and the English release carry the same facts; the filing gave nothing language-specific, as expected for a Nordic issuer.
Placera (Swedish, 2026-04-14) gave the explicit read of the reaction function: the Q1 fall was blamed on organic growth missing the 15% target. No English wire carried that explanation.
Finwire's Swedish summary of Redeye's Q2 review gives fair value 31 SEK where the English Börsvärlden version says 30; a minor discrepancy, not load-bearing.
The FI insynsregister (Swedish) carries Kallblad's August purchases; I found no English write-up.
TV4/TT (Swedish) carries VGR's final Millennium termination of 2026-08-27; there was no English coverage tying it to Carasent.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': cut the Infosolutions finding from +0.4 to +0.3 and the Q2 momentum finding from +0.5 to +0.3, because both restate disclosed Q2 and deal facts.

'Too small about the move; numbers new -> about 7%': raised abs_move_pct from 6.0 to 7.0. The period is not pre-released, turnover is thin ($112k a day), and observed report-day reactions here were 0, 1.7, 1.7, 5.0, 6.7, 7.25 and 8.8%.
'Reaction history moves p_up, not size' plus an unsourced bar: trimmed p_up from 55 to 54.

'Cash can outweigh': kept the cash-flow finding but trimmed it from -0.3 to -0.2, since this name looked through a 2.5 MSEK OCF quarter in Q3 2025; the insider finding went from +0.3 to +0.2 as a proxy.
